description: The find_header_value function in common/mod.rs (lines 2554-2561) matches headers by scanning for the first line beginning with 'Field-Name:'. RFC 5322 §2.2.3 allows long header values to be folded across multiple lines (continuation lines start with whitespace). If any header in an MDN blob is folded (e.g. a long Reporting-UA or Original-Recipient), find_header_value will return only the first line fragment, silently dropping the continuation. This affects parse_mdns for any real-world MDN blob with long header values. The function has no comment warning of this limitation.
title: mdn find_header_value: no folded-header support
